analysis: The pinned helper accepts one narrowly defined difference: recorded environment.PATH. It requires the exact retained-run digest and exact native08 sanitized PATH value/digest. It compares every other selected recorded field and all non-PATH environment entries, and normalizes capture-root strings only in argv and cwd.

The comparator independently binds the immutable retained run and native08 control-result/capture run, exact request and worker invocation, expected source head, 130-row ledger, pending/control plans, retained runtime modules, native tools, and helper bytes. It validates the six-case on/off roster, 12 records, 36 ordered phase commands, unique raw/command refs, and exact identities. The captured-input audit records 12 retained rows, 12 native08 rows, and 36 phase commands with only environment.PATH changed.

The audit explicitly leaves ambient OS environment equivalence, command-input equivalence, timing certification, relative performance conclusions, full-model qualification, scoring, and publication false. This is a recorded-field comparison only.

Observer08 retains observer07's source and behavior outside load_original. The focused test compares all declared functions/classes and prior constants, allowing only the loader extension and two helper pins. load_original pins and loads the separate helper, installs only its comparator callback on the in-memory retained module, and retains the original historical-binding checker.

Finalizer13 selects observer07 for the captured request and observer08 only for post-capture comparison. It validates the same seven exact input refs, checks the immutable native request/source closure and existing capture reviews, applies the comparator to the exact retained/native08 runs, then runs the existing production pending-plan replay and preflight. The production preflight repeats the comparator and requires its audit to equal the initial audit.

The finalizer preserves the immutable 130-row ledger and the existing 12-arm/36-phase semantic-only checks. Scope cleanup exits before _publish_after_cleanup. The publisher rechecks the candidate, ledger, exact command-delta audit ref/content, and semantic-only fields before writing the eligible plan and finalization receipt.

limitations_and_conditions: Attempt07 is a fresh output namespace and was absent at review time. This source approval is for attempt07 only and does not authorize reusing or relabeling attempt06.

The finalizer CLI permits any fresh directory under its native-finalization namespace. The root invocation must use the exact attempt-07 output_dir and execution-plan.json path recorded above, with the same seven refs; it must not derive a successor from provisional attempt06 output.

The finalizer writes the eligible plan before the enclosing post-capture receipt. If a later write fails, an eligible-plan file may remain without a complete receipt. Treat completion as accepted only after the attempt-07 process exits successfully and both exact output refs validate; never infer completion from the plan file alone.
